add_namespace = COLDWAR_YUG

country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_YUG.1
	title = COLDWAR_YUG.1.t
	desc = COLDWAR_YUG.1.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_Funerali_di_Stato

	is_triggered_only = yes

	immediate = {
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_YUG.1"
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_tito_dead
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_old_marshal }
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_presidency_next_federal_president } swap_ideas = { remove_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_old_marshal add_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_federal_president } }
			else_if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_presidency_next_confederal_presidium } swap_ideas = { remove_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_old_marshal add_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_confederal_presidium } }
			else = { swap_ideas = { remove_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_old_marshal add_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_collective_presidency } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_leader = { name = "Josip Broz Tito" ruling_only = yes } }
			hidden_effect = { kill_country_leader = yes }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 4 } } MDCW_HP_native_pool_SER_4 = yes }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 4 } NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_tito_successor_set } } MDCW_HP_native_pool_SER_4 = yes }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_tito_successor_set
		COLDWAR_YUG_refresh_lever_costs = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_YUG.1.a
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_YUG.1 option a"
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_YUG_tito_dead_tt
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_YUG.10
	title = COLDWAR_YUG.10.t
	desc = COLDWAR_YUG.10.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_riot

	trigger = {
		original_tag = SER
		IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
		has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_initialized
		NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_federation_dissolved }
		check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_croatia > 74 }
		NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_crisis_cd_croatia }
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = { days = 30 }

	immediate = {
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_YUG.10"
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_YUG_crisis_cd_croatia days = 1095 value = 1 }
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_YUG.10.a
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_YUG.10 option a"
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_YUG_disc_croatia_m15_tt
		hidden_effect = { set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_delta = -15 } COLDWAR_YUG_change_disc_croatia = yes }
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_YUG_disc_serbia_p8_tt
		hidden_effect = { set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_delta = 8 } COLDWAR_YUG_change_disc_serbia = yes }
		add_political_power = -50
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_YUG.10.b
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_YUG.10 option b"
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_YUG_disc_croatia_m25_tt
		hidden_effect = { set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_delta = -25 } COLDWAR_YUG_change_disc_croatia = yes }
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_YUG_disc_later_croatia_p10_365_tt
		hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_YUG.208 days = 365 } }
		add_stability = -0.04
		set_temp_variable = { party_index = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { party_popularity_increase = 0.02 }
		set_temp_variable = { temp_outlook_increase = 0.02 }
		change_relative_party_popularity = yes
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_YUG.20
	title = COLDWAR_YUG.20.t
	desc = COLDWAR_YUG.20.d
	picture = GFX_ICW_EVT_country_report_event_generic_parliament

	trigger = {
		original_tag = SER
		IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
		has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_initialized
		has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_tito_dead
		NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_federation_dissolved }
		NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_confederal_union }
		OR = {
			count_triggers = {
				amount = 3
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_slovenia > 89 }
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_croatia > 89 }
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_serbia > 89 }
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_bosnia > 89 }
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_montenegro > 89 }
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_macedonia > 89 }
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_kosovo > 89 }
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_vojvodina > 89 }
			}
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_months_at_90 > 11 }
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = { days = 20 }

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_YUG.20.a
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_YUG.20 option a"
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_YUG_confederation_tt
		hidden_effect = { if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_cost_crisis_confederation_25 } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_delta = -25 } } else = { set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_delta = -20 } } COLDWAR_YUG_change_disc_slovenia = yes COLDWAR_YUG_change_disc_croatia = yes COLDWAR_YUG_change_disc_serbia = yes COLDWAR_YUG_change_disc_bosnia = yes COLDWAR_YUG_change_disc_montenegro = yes COLDWAR_YUG_change_disc_macedonia = yes COLDWAR_YUG_change_disc_kosovo = yes COLDWAR_YUG_change_disc_vojvodina = yes }
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_confederal_union
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_YUG.20.b
		trigger = {
			OR = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_jna_loyalty > 49 } COLDWAR_YUG_party_jna_governs = yes }
		}
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_YUG.20 option b"
		COLDWAR_YUG_release_above_75 = yes
		COLDWAR_YUG_dissolve = yes
		add_stability = -0.10
		add_war_support = 0.10

	}

	}
}
